Re: A partnered venue program for Los Angeles: Kings Court Partner Packs
1 message

Rap Commissioners <rap.commissioners@lacity.org>  Tue, Nov 3, 2026 at 8:23 AM
To: David Finlay

 Good morning,
 Thank you for contacting the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners Office, your email will be forwarded to the Commissioners and staff.

 On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 10:00 AM David Finlay  wrote:
  Hello Jimmy,

  I am writing to you in Los Angeles because Kings Court already maps the courts, courses and venues your residents play on, and cities like yours are where our players are most active.

  I am David Finlay, co-founder of Kings Court, the location based sports platform at  with over 500,000 courts, courses and venues in 100+ countries across basketball, pickleball,
  tennis, golf and pool. Players claim real venues by showing up and winning, defend their crown, and climb their city leaderboard. It gets people outside, active, and playing together in their own
  neighbourhoods.
